title: Automatic passing silently replaces the ball handler
expected: Selecting player 4 and choosing automatic delivery preserves player 4.
repro: Draft five → Passing options → starter 4 → Use automatic passing.
fix: Direct always-visible handler action; preserve starter in all delivery changes.

title: The game loop is split across a scrolling dashboard
expected: Draw, run, watch and retry in one court-sized view.
observed: Large heading, toolbar and side form compete; result/actions require scrolling at phone sizes.
repro: Draft five → inspect full game screen → run.
code: old src/main.jsx and style.css game layout
fix: Viewport-fitted arena with HUD, court and persistent action dock.

title: First possession gives instructions instead of a playable introduction
expected: Try one cut with a visible action and immediate feedback.
observed: Starter drawing and explanatory panel, no short interactive first-play cue.
fix: Optional three-step on-court introduction and editable plays.

title: Draft identity is overwhelmed by statistics and repeated status
expected: Quickly compare basketball strengths and pick a legend for an open slot.
observed: Large introductory copy, repeated position information and five stat columns before every pick.
fix: Jersey cards with compact strengths; details on demand; filled positions compact.

title: No evidence that ordinary teams can comfortably finish
expected: All five levels have practical winning approaches with normal randomness.
observed: Existing full-ladder UI check forces every outcome; only single-possession ordinary UI evidence.
repro: Inspect tests/browser/game.spec.js runWithRandom and ladder test.
fix: Varied-lineup probability/retry measurements plus unmodified-randomness browser ladders.

title: Screen movement cannot continue into a roll
expected: Route through a screen then to the rim plants briefly and continues.
observed: Only final route endpoint can plant; continuing the drawing removes that pick.
repro: Extend a setter route beyond its screen endpoint.
fix: Infer an intermediate screen point with approach, plant and roll phases.

title: Hover motion makes the next Play button jitter
expected: After practice or a result, Play remains a stable click target.
observed: The old hover translation oscillated when a changed label left the pointer at its edge; the walkthrough could not click Play.
repro: Complete warm-up, click Start challenge, then click Play from the same pointer position.
fix: Keep primary action geometry stationary on hover; retain color and shadow feedback.

title: Small-phone controls extend beyond the viewport
expected: All main actions fit at 320 px without horizontal scrolling or clipping.
observed: Intrinsic grid sizing widened the court and dock; the ladder also exceeded its track.
repro: Draft five, use 320×640 viewport, inspect each control bounding box.
code: src/style.css arena grid and compact ladder
fix: Give the arena an explicit minmax(0,1fr) column, constrain court sizing and tighten only the smallest ladder spacing.

title: A basic cut receives an incidental planted screen
expected: The Cut starter teaches movement; Screen teaches a pick.
observed: A stationary template teammate occupied the cut’s path, implicitly screening without that being the play’s lesson.
repro: Inspect default Cut plan and actual contact events.
fix: Spread inactive teammates away from the cut. Screen and Roll starters still create actual contact.

title: Close-range shot arc can clip above the court
expected: The ball stays visible from release through the rim.
observed: Full-speed footage showed an oversized close-range arc reaching the top boundary.
repro: Run a close-range pick and roll and inspect the shot phase.
fix: Use a bounded 40-unit arc, preserving one visible ball and the rim landing.
